press_references.value: Juicy Marbles launches plant-based Pork-ish protein

product_launches.description: Juicy Marbles has launched a new plant-based meat alternative called Pork-ish in the UK, following its success in the US. The product is a soy protein-based mini loin and is part of the company's new Meaty Meat range, designed to be a versatile and affordable plant-based protein. Pork-ish will be available in Tesco stores starting April 30, 2025.

press_references.value: North America Superfood Market Forecast Report 2025-2033 | Plant-Based and Clean Label Foods Propel Superfood Popularity and Growth - ResearchAndMarkets.com

product_launches.description: Juicy Marbles, a Slovenian alternative meat firm, launched Meaty Meat, a whole-cut plant-based lamb substitute, in the US and Canada in February 2025. This is the company's first lamb-style offering and aims to provide an affordable plant-based option.
A new product launching mid-January for Veganuary.

overview_description.description: Juicy marbles make thick juicy and marbled plant-based steaks. They are a food-tech company. They developed proprietary protein texturing technology that enables us to produce plant-based whole cuts. Our vision is to produce a variety of meat products and match animal-derived counterparts by taste, price and convenience. We want to accelerate transition of meat industry into a more sustainable future - by 2030 we want to cut meat consumption in half.

about_short_description.short_description: Juicy marbles make thick juicy and marbled plant based steaks.

product.name: Whole-Cut Loin
product.description: A plant-based loin designed to be cooked as a large cut or portioned into steaks, chunks, shreds, or strips for meals such as stir-fries, briskets, and sandwiches.

product.name: Thick-Cut Filet
product.description: A thick plant-based filet designed for steak-style meals, lunches, and brunch dishes, with individual portions available through the Juicy Marbles shop.

product.name: Meaty Meat Pork-ish
product.description: A plant-based pork-style protein for use in bowls, wraps, salads, sandwiches, and other everyday meals.

product.name: Baby Ribs
product.description: Plant-based ribs intended for barbecue, dinner, and other dishes traditionally prepared with bone-in ribs.

product.name: Kinda Salmon
product.description: A plant-based fish filet designed for meals that use salmon-style portions, including plated entrees and other seafood-inspired dishes.

product.name: Kinda Cod
product.description: A flaky plant-based fish filet for seafood-inspired entrees and other recipes requiring a cod-style portion.
